# Falcata Run

> Falcata Run is a watchOS-first sprint training app for track and field sprinters running the 100m, 200m, 400m, and 800m. It captures motion data at 100 Hz on Apple Watch and delivers sprint-specific metrics — reaction time, drive force, cadence, stride length, arm drive efficiency, and time to max speed — that generic running apps cannot measure. Tagline: "The gold standard for sprint tracking." Website: https://falcatarun.com

> Built by Radim Šimánek (https://github.com/Rad1m, https://www.linkedin.com/in/radim-simanek/). Sister app to Ahimo (https://ahimo.app), a privacy-first iOS health app. Personal blog: https://brainintheloop.com.

## Falcata Analyzer (macOS)

Falcata Analyzer is a native macOS app (macOS 15+) that opens sprint sessions exported from the iPhone and reuses the same engine as the Watch and iPhone (single source of truth — no separate desktop calculation path). It provides synchronized velocity / drive force / power / acceleration / arm-swing / ground-contact charts on one shared playhead, pop-out chart windows, a video editing workspace (link external footage, align to acceleration onset, trim, frame-accurate scrub, edit Start/Finish/Distance markers), a configurable telemetry video overlay, and export to video (H.264 MP4/QuickTime with resolution/FPS/bitrate control), chart images (PNG/JPEG), and CSV. It also supports standalone video analysis (open any video with no linked sprint and mark Start/Finish/Distance markers to measure velocity and acceleration, the same marker-based method as the web analyzer) and a Team Roster for organizing athletes and assigning their sessions and videos. It replaced the earlier Python desktop video/analysis tooling. Falcata Analyzer also includes an optional AI Sprint Coach with three provider tiers — on-device Apple Intelligence, on-device local MLX/Hugging Face open models, or bring-your-own-key cloud APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter) — including a chat that retrieves facts across the whole imported sprint history. On-device providers keep all data on the Mac; any cloud use is gated behind an explicit risk consent. (AI coaching is a macOS-Analyzer feature; the iPhone and Watch apps do not require or include it.)

## Falcata Web Analyzer (web)

Falcata Web Analyzer (https://app.falcatarun.com) is a free, install-free, browser-only companion that brings Falcata's marker-based video analysis to any sprint clip — no Apple Watch, no account, no upload. The user opens a local video, scrubs it frame by frame, and places distance markers (Start / Distance / Finish, with a single Start at 0 m and a single Finish) and ground contact time (GCT) contact→toe-off spans. From those markers it derives per-segment velocity, launch acceleration, and a sprint summary (duration, max average speed, start acceleration), validates markers against the Start–Finish window (out-of-bounds flagging), draws a WYSIWYG overlay, and exports a PNG, a short sprint-window video clip (WebM/MP4 with source audio), or a CSV (SI columns). Display units switch between metric and imperial. Markers, playhead, and units auto-save per video file in the browser (IndexedDB); video bytes are never stored or uploaded. It also includes AI Vision: on-device pose analysis on a marked section that traces a frame-by-frame skeleton, detects foot strikes and measures ground contact automatically (read-only AI GCT bars), counts contacts split left/right, and flags overstriding (foot landing ahead of the body, possible/likely severity). AI Vision runs entirely in the browser with no upload, persists results per video file, and in V1 analyzes one section at a time (sections over 30 seconds are blocked). This is on-device computer-vision pose analysis, distinct from the LLM-based AI Sprint Coach, which is a macOS-Analyzer-only feature. Unlike the Watch/iPhone/Mac apps it does not use 100 Hz sensor telemetry — it is the manual, hardware-free, video-only side of Falcata, complementary to Falcata Analyzer on macOS (which overlays measured Watch telemetry on footage). Built with React + Vite, hosted on Netlify; analytics are strictly opt-in behind a cookie-consent banner.

## Key facts

- App name: Falcata Run (also referred to as Falcata Sprint Run)
- Platforms: Apple Watch (primary), iPhone (iOS companion), Mac (Falcata Analyzer, macOS 15+ desktop review/video/export app), Web (Falcata Web Analyzer, browser-only marker-based video tool at app.falcatarun.com)
- Target distances: 100m, 200m, 400m, 800m, plus free runs
- Audience: sprinters, sprint coaches, track and field teams, masters athletes
- Sample rate: 100 Hz accelerometer, gyroscope, and gravity
- Reaction time accuracy: ±10 milliseconds
- Sprint end detection: 3-phase piecewise linear fit (validated 20m–800m)
- Distance source: Apple sensor-fused track-aware distance samples (not raw GPS polyline)
- Key algorithms: velocity-differentiation propulsive G-force, gyroscope peak/bottom step detection, curve compensation with centripetal removal and wrist-aware asymmetry scaling
- Website: https://falcatarun.com
